description: Zukünftiges Erzeugungssystem unter UnSicherheiten (ZEUS) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Institute of Power Systems and Power Economics (IAEW) at RWTH Aachen University. expansion planning of thermal power plants and storage technologies. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Time resolution: hour, Adaptive, variable time patterns. Spatial resolution: All Bidding Zones in ENTSO-E region. Software: not given. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
